title: ParcelFlow
tagline: Cloud ELT pipeline + order-volume forecasting on real Olist data
highlights: Idempotent ELT pipeline ingesting 98.5K real Olist e-commerce orders across 595 daily partitions and 27 Brazilian states into a star-schema warehouse.
14-day SARIMA forecaster that beat a seasonal-naive baseline by ~40% MAPE (25.1% vs 42.1%) across the 5 highest-volume states.
Data-quality stage quarantining inconsistent orders with reasons, plus a run log for observability; swappable SQLite/Postgres and local/Azure backends.
